stories.headline: Ashton Jeanty Went Down Divin' for a Catch, and Every First-Round Wagon Just Hit a Rut
stories.read: Pardner, the Raiders' bell-cow dove for a ball Sunday, ran smack into his own cornerback, and got helped off that practice field without puttin' a lick of weight on that right leg. The good word is it's believed low and not high, which is the difference between missin' a week and missin' a month, and Vegas is hopeful for the September opener against Miami. But hopeful ain't a wagon I'd bet my whole outfit on. Don't you dare panic-sell a top-five back over a low sprain, but if you're drafting this week, quietly stake Raheem Mostert or whoever's next in that pecking order as your spare horse, because that handcuff just went from worthless to the cheapest insurance on the Trail.

stories.headline: Chuba Hubbard's Hamstring Is Week-to-Week, and Jonathon Brooks Just Turned Into Cheap Gold
stories.read: Dave Canales says he's confident his starter is good for Week 1, and he's holdin' him out of the second preseason game anyhow. Now I've been on this Trail a long time and I'll tell you plain: a hamstring is the meanest injury there is, because it heals just enough to fool a fella into runnin' full speed, then snaps him right back to the wagon. Even at full health this was headed for a committee with Jonathon Brooks splittin' the reins. So go stake Brooks late in every draft you're sittin' in, because you're payin' pennies for a back who might carry the whole Carolina haul in September while your leaguemates are still readin' the depth chart from June.

stories.headline: The Land Grab Comes Two Days Early: 1,184 Fellas Hit the Open Range by Sunday
stories.read: Heads up, because the league moved the 53-man cutdown to 6 p.m. Eastern this Sunday, August 30th, two days sooner than the Tuesday you're used to. That means better than eleven hundred players get turned loose onto unclaimed territory while half your outfit is still arguin' about who won the mock draft. Arizona already waived Trey Benson, the Raiders let Noah Brown go, and there's more comin' Sunday. Here's the play: don't draft your bench full of dead weight before the weekend, keep two roster spots open, and be the fella refreshin' the wire Sunday night when a real backfield or a No. 2 receiver lands somewhere with actual snaps waitin' for him. Free land goes to whoever stakes it first.
